$comment: Global switchboard. Everything that is not clinic copy lives here: domain, theme, typography, feature toggles, analytics. Edit this file first when you set up a new clinic.
$url: The live domain. Canonical links, the sitemap, social previews and structured data are built from it. Leave it blank on Vercel and the deployment URL is used automatically.

locale.$timeZone: The clinic's own time zone. The live 'Open now' indicator is calculated in it, whatever time zone the visitor is in.

theme.$comment: Set these hex values and the entire site recolours. Every tint, gradient, hairline and shadow is derived from them at runtime — no Tailwind rebuild, no CSS edits.
theme.$overrides: Optional. Any token here wins over the derived value, e.g. { "line": "#D2D2D7" }.

fonts.$comment: Apple devices use San Francisco, the system font. Everyone else gets `family`: Inter, Manrope, DM Sans or Plus Jakarta Sans. Set appleSystemFont to false to use `family` everywhere.

features.$comment: Turn whole capabilities on or off without deleting code or breaking links. A disabled route is removed from the nav, the footer and the sitemap, and returns 404.

announcement.$comment: Thin bar above the header. Set features.announcement to true to show it.
announcement.text: Now open on Sundays, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM.

analytics.$comment: Leave blank to load nothing at all. No third-party script is injected unless an id is present.

openGraph.$comment: Leave image blank to auto-generate a branded card from the clinic name and tagline.
